interpretation: Descriptive observations only. No accepted or raised import/render/replay SLO; no milestone closure.
Root-owned local Vite preview of an exactly censused production build; not deployed CDN/traffic or production hardware.
Fresh context per sample; one shared browser. Browser HTTP cache disabled. Existing OS/server file caches are not flushed.
First-open combines production lazy chunks, embedded retained strings, hash/parser validation and React DOM. Manifest-selected ResourceTiming is chunk transport, not isolated parser/import CPU.
Warm reopen reuses modules in that page. Readiness then two animation frames is not a paint-completion guarantee.
Narrow viewport is 390x844 DPR1 desktop Chromium, not a mobile-device or mobile-hardware measurement.
Selections are retained logical data navigation. Reverse/repeat timings are checkpoint selection, not debugger replay/execution latency.
No synthetic fixture is measured; synthetic unit controls cannot be treated as performance observations.
No forced GC. Heap is renderer-isolate data; OS process-tree RSS is non-atomic and shared pages can be counted twice.
Browser heap/process samples are checkpoints, not peaks. Node client RSS is separate, not browser RSS.
No physical register, lifetime, microstep, GPU, resume, edit, compilation or source ownership authority.
